title: An import update of an old COD customer clears its stored limit
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You re-import a COD customer that still has a $1,000 limit from before the release.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds COD and keeps a credit limit of $1,000.00 stored from before the release.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S10-08 Customer.
  • A contacts import file that updates {Customer-A} with a new phone number, the credit term "COD" and an empty credit limit cell.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the import finishes; no row is refused because of its credit term.
  • Step 2: Credit Limit shows $0.00, disabled; the stored $1,000.00 is gone because the import updated the customer.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • Key Decisions: “The rule applies only to customers created or edited after release: an existing COD or Credit Hold customer with a limit stored from before keeps it until the customer is next edited in Edit Customer, updated by the contacts import, or updated through the Public API with a credit term or credit limit or moved to COD or Credit Hold by Move Customers; each of those saves $0.”
  • S10-E2: “Credit limits sent with an import or API customer are handled as today, except as S10-R6 and S10-R8 state. Both apply only to customers created or updated after release; an existing COD or Credit Hold customer's stored limit is never changed until that customer is next created or updated by one of those paths (S11-R11).”
  • S10-R8: “A customer created or updated through the Public API, or updated by the contacts import, onto COD or Credit Hold is saved with a $0 credit limit, whatever limit was sent; the request or row is not refused (S10-N1). A Public API update that sends neither a credit term nor a credit limit leaves the stored limit as it is.”
